subject: Proposal: commit-fluctuation policy and tactical GPU supplement for PulseAI renewal
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@pulseai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sonal Gupta <sonal.gupta@pulseai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 usage spike + renewal sizing

Evelyn —

Quick summary from our side: we saw a sustained increase in generation and fine-tune traffic in November (peak sustained concurrency up ~2.8x vs July). I attached a small CSV with daily token/instance utilization and a flag where latency-sensitive traffic peaked.

We're approaching our renewal and want to understand a few things:
- What a safe GPU supplement looks like for the next 3 months while we stabilize usage.
- If there are short-term burst options vs committing to a tranche.
- How Redwood would handle utilization-driven reprofile if our usage declines after the holiday window.

Can we get a short proposal and indicative pricing? Also looping procurement (cc) since contract changes may be required.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform
PulseAI
(attachment: usage_snapshot_Q4.csv)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@pulseai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 usage spike + renewal sizing

Alex —

Thanks for the data. I reviewed the CSV and pulled a quick back-of-envelope. Short answers up front:
- We recommend a tactical supplement of +12 H100-equivalent GPUs for an initial 8-week runway, with a staged rollback plan if utilization dips below 40% sustained.
- Burst credits are available for immediate spikes; however, for predictability we propose a short-term tranche (monthly commit) paired with a smaller burst buffer.
- We can include an automatic reprofile clause in the SOW that allows a one-time reallocation (up or down) after the 8-week observation window based on agreed utilization signals.

Attached: high-level options will be sent by Kimberly (pricing + SOW mocks). Ben — can you add the suggested commitment language and escalation SLAs?

Next steps:
1) Kimberly to send pricing matrix and two SOW variants (tranche vs burst-first).
2) Procurement to confirm required PO/contracting timeline.
3) Technical call if PulseAI wants kernel/sequence-length tuning recommendations (Ben/Karthik).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: PulseAI: provisioning options (v2) + price bands

Team —

Drafted two commercial paths in the attached workbook:
- Option A (Reserve tranche): +12 H100eq reserved for 3 months, blended unit price with a mid-term reconciliation. Ideal if PulseAI expects sustained uplift.
- Option B (Burst-first + short commit): +6 reserved + 40% burst buffer; higher marginal price for bursts but lower committed spend.

Key commercial points to surface to the customer:
• Reprofile clause: one re-calibration permitted between weeks 6–10 based on rolling 7-day utilization metric.
• Auto-fallback: if reserved capacity is saturated, requests route to a compatible quantized variant (no SLA penalty for fallback).
• Billing reconciliation: overage or underuse is reconciled monthly with clear math.

I also included a SOW stub and suggested DocuSign path. I marked fields that procurement will typically redline (term length, termination for convenience).

(attachment: provisioning_options_v2.xlsx)

-Kim

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PulseAI: provisioning options (v2) + price bands

Quick technical note to seed the SOW:

Sizing rationale (short):
- Observed peak sustained token throughput suggests the effective concurrency requirement equals ~12 H100eq for latency at 95th pct targets.
- If PulseAI enables prefix caching for 60% of calls (as they indicated in the CSV), effective token cost drops ~18% and we can safely test a +8 GPU pilot instead of +12.
- Recommendation: start with Option B (6 reserved + burst buffer) + conditional doubling to +12 if rolling 7-day utilization > 65% for 5 consecutive days.

Operational guardrails:
- Autoscale policy: 30% headroom threshold for automatic burst; fallbacks to quantized variants under sustained saturation.
- Observability: add token-level trace and 95/99 latency dashboards as part of the SOW.

I'll draft the technical appendix that lists exact metrics and thresholds to make the reprofile deterministic.

-Karthik

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@pulseai.com>, Procurement <procurement@pulseai.com>, Sonal Gupta <sonal.gupta@pulseai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: PulseAI next steps: SOW + decision checkpoints

Alex / Sonal / procurement —

Following our internal alignment, attached is the proposed SOW and two commercial routes: Reserve tranche (Option A) and Burst-first hybrid (Option B). Highlights:
- We recommend Option B to minimize upfront commit while preserving a clear path to +12 GPUs if utilization justifies it.
- Reprofile/trigger: documented threshold (rolling 7-day >65% for 5 days) that will automatically initiate capacity uplift subject to a one-week notice window.
- Billing: monthly reconciliation; overages billed at burst rates and reconciled into next month’s invoice.

Please review the attached SOW and let us know which option you prefer. If procurement is happy, I’ll send the DocuSign link and propose a Go/No-go by Friday, Dec 24 to ensure capacity is in place before the holiday uplift.

Attachments: SOW_PulseAI_GPU_supplement.pdf

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
